comments.author: Kicker
comments.body: can anyone do a walkthrough on how to do this quest? Please/Thanks. :D

comments.author: Donce
comments.body:
I pulled this quest having R9 ecological research, R12 biology and R3+3 survival.

1. Talk to Mehmet Shuluk in Alexandria 3 times
4. Talk to tavern keeper in Calcutta (not Calicut)
5. Chongqing - talk to tavern keeper
6. Chongqing - talk to Girl 2 times
8. Southeast Chongqing - click on the Large Boulder
9. Southeast Chongqing - click on the Upturned Boulder

Ecological search near Upturned Boulder. You do not need R5 survival while doing ecological search. It means that you need Rank 5 survival only to pull the quest.

comments.author: Jean
comments.body:
R5 Survival is needed to talk to Mehmet Shuluk in Alexandria. It is not needed for any other steps.

The large boulder for step 8 is on the western side of the map.
The upturned boulder for step 9 is in the northeast corner.
